title: Dividers eat drawer width
hook: Which estimate leaves room for four compartments?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Dividers occupy space too. The usable width of each compartment is the drawer width minus the internal walls, divided by the number of compartments.
